$description: Closed asset-role registry built from real usage sites in src/ and public/. Roles are a CLOSED enum; a generator may not invent a role.

generationPolicyMeaning.may-generate-new: New assets may be generated (non-identifying, decorative only).
generationPolicyMeaning.must-reuse-exact: Only the exact existing file/inline SVG may be used; no redraws.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-fabricate: Only existing real files may be referenced; never generate, alter or invent.
generationPolicyMeaning.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: Do not embed or copy the live third-party URL/token; use a placeholder.

globalProhibitions: Do not reproduce real third-party or company logos (customer, press, investor, competitor, employer, integration, store badges) by redrawing, tracing or generating them.
Do not generate, edit or substitute photos or videos of real people, and do not fabricate names, titles or quotes for them.
Do not reproduce real proprietary content (product UI, footage, blog covers, copy) as newly generated material presented as the real thing.
Do not copy live endpoints, tokens or account ids from the source.

pinnedRoles.$note: Compliance-critical roles and the exact generationPolicy each MUST carry. Stage 3 turns this into a pinned-value check.

brand-mark.description: Reevo wordmark and square footer mark, rendered as inline SVG from svgPaths.js
brand-mark.licensingGuidance: Reevo trademark. Reuse the exact path data from src/components/svgPaths.js; never redraw or alter proportions or colour (uses currentColor).

customer-logo.description: Customer logos in the home marquee and testimonial cards
customer-logo.licensingGuidance: Real customers' trademarks. This is a real company's site. Never redraw, restyle, approximate or AI-generate a real third-party logo; only reference the exact existing file. Do not invent customer names or logos.

press-logo.description: Press outlet logos in the 'As seen on' row, each linking to a real article
press-logo.licensingGuidance: Real publishers' trademarks and real article links. This is a real company's site. Never redraw, restyle, approximate or AI-generate a real third-party logo; only reference the exact existing file. Do not invent press coverage.

investor-logo.description: Investor logos / cards on About and Startups pages
investor-logo.licensingGuidance: Real investors' trademarks. This is a real company's site. Never redraw, restyle, approximate or AI-generate a real third-party logo; only reference the exact existing file. Do not imply investment relationships that are not in the source.

competitor-logo.description: Competitor logo cards on the compare pages (e.g. a HubSpot card)
competitor-logo.licensingGuidance: Third-party trademarks used for comparison. This is a real company's site. Never redraw, restyle, approximate or AI-generate a real third-party logo; only reference the exact existing file.

employer-logo.description: Logos of companies team members previously worked at (careers page)
employer-logo.licensingGuidance: Third-party trademarks. This is a real company's site. Never redraw, restyle, approximate or AI-generate a real third-party logo; only reference the exact existing file.

integration-logo.description: Locally stored integration partner logos (overrides of the logo.dev feed)
integration-logo.licensingGuidance: Third-party trademarks. This is a real company's site. Never redraw, restyle, approximate or AI-generate a real third-party logo; only reference the exact existing file. Remote logo.dev URLs are governed by the third-party-embed role.

person-portrait.description: Photos of real leadership, customers and testimonial authors
person-portrait.licensingGuidance: Real individuals. Depicts real, identifiable people. Never generate, alter, composite or substitute a person's face/likeness, name or quote attribution; reuse the exact supplied file or leave a neutral placeholder slot.

editorial-photo.description: Photographs of people in work scenes (problem cards, newsletter, startups, mobile surfaces)
editorial-photo.licensingGuidance: Photographs of real or stock-licensed people, some watermarked. Depicts real, identifiable people. Never generate, alter, composite or substitute a person's face/likeness, name or quote attribution; reuse the exact supplied file or leave a neutral placeholder slot. Licence of the originals is unknown; do not redistribute.

product-screenshot.description: Screenshots and UI renders of Reevo's product
product-screenshot.licensingGuidance: Proprietary product UI. Do not generate fake product UI that claims to be Reevo screens, and do not invent metrics, customer data or names in UI imagery; reuse the exact file.

decorative-pattern.description: Abstract dot/halftone pattern strips and backgrounds
decorative-pattern.licensingGuidance: Decorative and non-identifying; new patterns may be generated in the same halftone style, or the existing files reused. Must carry no text, logos or people.

video-teaser.description: Reevo promo / tour teaser videos and poster
video-teaser.licensingGuidance: Proprietary Reevo footage. Reuse the exact file; do not synthesise product video.

testimonial-video.licensingGuidance: Real customers speaking. Depicts real, identifiable people. Never generate, alter, composite or substitute a person's face/likeness, name or quote attribution; reuse the exact supplied file or leave a neutral placeholder slot.

nav-thumbnail.description: Square product thumbnails in the nav dropdown and pricing cards
nav-thumbnail.licensingGuidance: Reevo product artwork; reuse the exact file.

blog-cover.licensingGuidance: Editorial images owned by Reevo or its licensors, some containing people or third-party brands. Reuse the exact file; do not synthesise a cover that implies a real article.

store-badge.description: App Store / Google Play badges and the download QR
store-badge.licensingGuidance: Apple and Google badge artwork is governed by their brand guidelines. Reuse the exact files; never redraw.

third-party-embed.description: Remote third-party content: Storylane demo iframes, the scheduler (cal.reevo.ai) dialog and logo.dev logo URLs
third-party-embed.licensingGuidance: Live third-party endpoints and account-bound URLs. Never copy or ship these URLs/tokens (the source contains a logo.dev publishable token and Storylane demo ids; they must not be reproduced). Render a neutral placeholder or local static stand-in.
